title: Differentiation of the integral
summary: The fundamental theorem of calculus for the Lebesgue integral; the Vitali covering theorem; the Hardy–Littlewood maximal function and its weak (1,1) bound; Lebesgue's differentiation theorem and Lebesgue points; the generalised Minkowski inequality, distribution functions and Marcinkiewicz interpolation (the maximal operator is bounded on L^p for p > 1).

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 22–24 of the 18.125 notes.

preparation.description: Read lecture 22: the fundamental theorem of calculus for the Lebesgue integral, the Vitali covering theorem, the maximal function and the Hardy–Littlewood weak (1,1) theorem.
Read lecture 23: Lebesgue's differentiation theorem, the Lebesgue set of an L^1 function, the fundamental theorem of calculus I.
Read lecture 24: the generalised Minkowski inequality, another proof of Young's inequality, distribution functions, Marcinkiewicz interpolation.
